reviews.title: Decent case for the money!
reviews.comment: This is a great case for the money. It has decent styling queues. Air flow or heat dissapation will not be an issue in this case, so if you’re running some heavy hardware they will breathe just fine in here. The fact that it comes with 4 ARGB fans pre-I stalled only makes the deal sweeter. Plant of space for upgrades and decent room for cable management especially at the top of the motherboard which provides room for an AIO. The build quality is to be expected at this price point. The noise level isn’t really that bad but noise typically isn’t an issue for me.
reviews.author: Raymond Middleton

reviews.title: Great Value for the Price, Longevity and Durability
reviews.comment: I love this case. It has tons of features, cool looking design, and an amazing price. One thing I would change is the waves on the front panel do make the fans slightly louder when attached but not to the point where it would be bothersome. I have been using this case for several months now and am still happy with the case. Great Value and durability.
reviews.author: tab00003

reviews.title: Great case for a first time build
reviews.comment: Love the look and ease of build. This is my first PC build and this case made cable management relatively easy. Plenty of time down support and comes with a few pre installed Velcro straps. The fans even though they run full speed all the time are still quiet. Great airflow through the case!
reviews.author: Cass556

reviews.title: Good value, easy to work with
reviews.comment: This case was easy to work with and easily fits triple slot graphics cards however, the gpu support bracket should be included, as this is a gaming case.
